The club currently plays home matches at the 16,416-seat [[Unipol Domus]]. Founded in 1920, they won their only ''[[Scudetto]]'' in [[1969–70 Serie A|1969–70]], when they were led by the [[Italy national football team|Italian national team]]'s all-time leading scorer, [[Gigi Riva]]. The triumph was also the first by a club from south of [[Rome]]. The club's best European performance was in the [[1993–94 UEFA Cup]], reaching the semi-finals before losing to eventual winners [[Inter Milan|Internazionale]]. As with the flag of its city, Cagliari's main colours are blue and red. The club badge incorporates the [[flag of Sardinia]]."}}
